corrections: Mapped the Whack-a-Hole source folder to whack_a_mole.

before: At the start of the game, all 9 holes are visible, no mole is visible, Score is 0, Time is 30, and the game waits 0.3 seconds before spawning the first mole.
after: At the start of the game, all 9 holes are visible, no mole is visible, Score is 0, Time is 30, and the game waits 0.15 seconds before spawning the first mole.

before: If a visible mole is clicked within its active duration, the corresponding score is awarded, the mole disappears immediately, and a 0.3-second waiting period begins.
If its appearance duration expires without a successful click, the mole disappears without changing the score and the same 0.3-second waiting period begins.
after: If a visible mole is clicked within its active duration, the corresponding score is awarded, the mole disappears immediately, and a 0.15-second waiting period begins.
If its appearance duration expires without a successful click, the mole disappears without changing the score and the same 0.15-second waiting period begins.

before: A successful click on a Normal Mole adds 1 point, while a successful click on a Golden Mole adds 3 points. The clicked mole then disappears immediately and a 0.3-second waiting period begins.
after: A successful click on a Normal Mole adds 1 point, while a successful click on a Golden Mole adds 3 points. The clicked mole then disappears immediately and a 0.15-second waiting period begins.

before: Clicks during the 0.3-second waiting period also have no effect. Invalid clicks never increase or decrease the score.
after: Clicks during the 0.15-second waiting period also have no effect. Invalid clicks never increase or decrease the score.

before: Restart resets the score, countdown, current mole, all mole-related timers, interface state, and game state. A new 0.3-second initial waiting period begins before the first mole appears.
after: Restart resets the score, countdown, current mole, all mole-related timers, interface state, and game state. A new 0.15-second initial waiting period begins before the first mole appears.

before: Normal Mole appearance duration is fixed at 1.0 second, Golden Mole appearance duration is fixed at 0.6 seconds, and the waiting period between moles is fixed at 0.3 seconds. These values do not change according to score, elapsed time, or the number of previously spawned moles.
after: Normal Mole appearance duration is fixed at 1.0 second, Golden Mole appearance duration is fixed at 0.6 seconds, and the waiting period between moles is fixed at 0.15 seconds. These values do not change according to score, elapsed time, or the number of previously spawned moles.

before: At initialization, the game creates the interface and 9 fixed holes, sets Score to 0 and Time to 30, clears the current mole, initializes all mole-related timers, enters `playing`, and starts a 0.3-second initial waiting period.
after: At initialization, the game creates the interface and 9 fixed holes, sets Score to 0 and Time to 30, clears the current mole, initializes all mole-related timers, enters `playing`, and starts a 0.15-second initial waiting period.

before: If Time remains above 0, the game updates the current mole cycle. During a waiting period, the waiting timer advances until one mole is spawned. While a mole is visible, its appearance timer advances and valid mouse clicks are processed. A successful click updates the score, removes the mole, and starts a new 0.3-second waiting period. If the appearance duration expires first, the mole is removed without changing the score and the same waiting period begins.
after: If Time remains above 0, the game updates the current mole cycle. During a waiting period, the waiting timer advances until one mole is spawned. While a mole is visible, its appearance timer advances and valid mouse clicks are processed. A successful click updates the score, removes the mole, and starts a new 0.15-second waiting period. If the appearance duration expires first, the mole is removed without changing the score and the same waiting period begins.

before: Pressing R fully reinitializes the game and starts a new 0.3-second initial waiting period.

The game contains no difficulty progression. Total duration remains 30 seconds, both initial and between-mole waiting periods remain 0.3 seconds, Normal Mole duration remains 1.0 second, Golden Mole duration remains 0.6 seconds, and Golden Mole probability remains 20%.
after: Pressing R fully reinitializes the game and starts a new 0.15-second initial waiting period.

The game contains no difficulty progression. Total duration remains 30 seconds, both initial and between-mole waiting periods remain 0.15 seconds, Normal Mole duration remains 1.0 second, Golden Mole duration remains 0.6 seconds, and Golden Mole probability remains 20%.

before: During `playing`, the bottom instruction area displays `Click the mole` and `Restart: R`. When Time reaches 0, the game enters `game_over`, the current mole disappears, Score stops changing, and the bottom area displays `Game Over` and `Press R to Restart`.
after: During `playing`, the bottom instruction area displays `Click the mole` and `Restart: R`.
When Time reaches 0, the game enters `game_over`, the current mole disappears, Score stops changing, and the bottom area displays `Game Over` and `Press R to Restart`.

before: After entering `game_over`, pressing R restores Score to 0, Time to 30, clears the current mole and all mole timers, restores the normal gameplay instructions, returns the state to `playing`, and begins a new 0.3-second initial waiting period.
after: After entering `game_over`, pressing R restores Score to 0, Time to 30, clears the current mole and all mole timers, restores the normal gameplay instructions, returns the state to `playing`, and begins a new 0.15-second initial waiting period.
